main_measure.name: OLS slope of 7-bar excess return on the forecast (forecast < 0 grid bars)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and mean unusual short move > 0); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move in the short direction (minus excess return)

decided_by: the slope t lies between -2 and 2
reading: the drift is each coin's mean 7-bar return on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows, the slope is in 7-bar excess return (fraction) per forecast point with CR1 day-clustered errors, and the plan's minimum counts lead to 'not observable' as the workflow requires
